public_payload.normalized_proposition: Transformer-based architecture is approaching its limits.

statement.excerpt: we're approaching the limits of transformer-based architecture

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that substantial further capability gains from transformer architecture were nearing exhaustion, rather than that existing models had particular weaknesses.

Because this describes an ongoing technical state, I assess July 2024 through the post date using the latest publicly reportable model results. There is no standard quarterly reporting period for architectural progress.
Approaching does not mean that all improvements had already stopped.
criteria.support_condition: Scaling studies and capability evaluations establish broad diminishing returns nearing an architectural ceiling at the time of the post, rather than a temporary data, compute, or benchmark limitation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes substantial remaining architectural headroom at that time across meaningful capabilities, sufficient to rebut near-exhaustion.
